name: Kimi wa Nandodemo Shini, Nandodemo Korosareru.
original_name: 君は何度でも死に、何度でも殺される。
source:
Nanamori Yozora has a penchant for getting aroused by the grotesque. He does his best to hide this aspect of himself, pretending to be normal, but when he meets Fujieda Mahiru, a boy who can comes back to life after dying, he finds himself unable to control his desires.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20853]Freem![/url]]
translation:
七森夜空喜欢被怪诞的事物所激发。他极力掩饰自己的这一面，假装正常，但当他遇到了能死而复生的男孩藤枝真昼时，他发现自己无法控制自己的欲望。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20853]Freem![/url]]
